label: The v4.0.0.3 entry has zero coverage of the 049 doctor work: a token sweep finds no doctor, /doctor:git, hook-gate or .sk-git mention, and the spec-folder list names only sk-communication/007, sk-git/032 and system-deep-loop/039. The entry needs a doctor/git-hooks section, at-a-glance bullets and specs/system-speckit/049-doctor-audit-followups in its header list.

Phase 001 trigger-index freshness is only half-covered: the entry names --scoring-only and the generator --check option, but not the doctor change where phase 0 runs generate-trigger-index.mjs --check --json as its verdict, the new index_content_stale signal judges content over mtime (mtime demoted to low-severity support), folder-token-fallback counting now matches the validator, and the index was regenerated over 23,056 documents with three sidecars.

Phases 002/005/006 release-updater changes are absent from the entry: generated file class with the derived-only graph-metadata rule, record-base writing .skilled/release/base.json plus baseRecording, --include-prerelease, alignment-free apply with plan.json/rollback.json run state, decisions-without-alignment refusal, the six phase-006 fixes (fully decided units, lock owner plus unlock, copied-tree base and --trust-release, plan-digest binding, routed rollback/record-base approval gates, rename linking plus a contract test), the 26 underlying research findings, and the rejected provenance_fingerprint pre-filter.

Phase 008 ownership split is missing and retires names the entry must never present as live: /doctor:skill-advisor (tune moved, rebuild new with sqlite backup/restore), /doctor:deep-loop and /doctor:runtime-mirrors created; /doctor:speckit reduced to retrieval with no target and a moved-target notice; /doctor:rebuild deleted with workflow, presentation, bootstrap, test, nine playbook scenarios and the v3.3 migration leg; fable-mode workflow, script, test and metrics module deleted; trigger index regenerated directly (commit 46ecac338c).

Phase 009 saved hook gate settings and /doctor:git are missing: gates.tsv lists 12 switchable gates (10 persistable, 2 per-push approvals), gate-config.sh in pre-commit, prepare-commit-msg and pre-push turns speckit.hooks.<key> set to off/false/no/0 into the gate's SPECKIT_SKIP_* variable for the run with one notice line, ignores git -c and GIT_CONFIG_* scope, and reads only in a trusted toolchain repo; /doctor:git hooks lists and edits gate values with approval, /doctor:git standards copies shipped sk-git templates into .sk-git/ once without overwriting, edits or removes rules blocks, rechecks with sk-git's shape check and reports stale prose; --dry-run writes nothing (commit e3626413cd).

Phase 010 mandatory router input gates are missing: /doctor:skill-advisor and /doctor:mcp now stop and show their menu when no target is given, never inferring one from the conversation or repository, and extract_structure.py exempts commands from the array-format allowed-tools rule (commit f4485249ed).

Phase 003/004 doctor gate and conformance work is missing: guard-owned mcp-mutation-class-manifest.yaml, route-validate assertion L1 (and later B3), twelve scripts fixed against false PASS and crashes, hub-contract check at 21 commands, mutation-class rows 7 to 21, mcp-doctor --fix removed, and one test runner run-all.sh wired into .github/workflows/spec-kit-check.yml (commit cc2d4ea5f2).

Phase 007 speckit router contract drift is missing: the contract schema gained a workflow purpose and optional commands list, the speckit family now names one shared workflow for plan/implement/complete with resume keeping its auto/confirm pair, and generate-command-routers.cjs applies an asset only to the routers its commands list names (commit 119c4ffb07).

sk-git/032 hook hardening is only partially covered: f7316afc6a maps to the Worktrees Use Their Own Validator paragraph and one sentence of e5b1ea84c7 appears there, but 9c99983374 (unreadable staged blob blocks except submodules, temp cleanup) and d1fe481584 (14 hook switches listed in ENV-REFERENCE section 5, hook README behavior corrections) are missing, along with e5b1ea84c7's common-dir/trustRepoHooks mechanism and 032/001's push-range-only-added-commits, Commit-Id rebased-copy, contract-dir command-scope and attribution-stripping fixes.

No statement in the entry is wrong or stale today: a sweep of v4.0.0.0 through v4.0.0.3 finds no /doctor:rebuild, /doctor:speckit, /doctor:skill-advisor or fable token, and the adjacent hook sentences remain true but incomplete. Text still to be written must use post-049 names and Upgrade Notes must add the doctor-target migration, saved gate settings, .sk-git/ ownership, first-run record-base and --include-prerelease lines.

Entry metadata and the header spec-folder list need the 049 packet: the title, description and four trigger phrases do not cover doctor commands or git-hook settings, the Also list omits 049-doctor-audit-followups, and the changelog README declares v4.0.0.3 still untagged so added content is in scope.
A changelog entry may describe only surface that exists at its tag: deleted commands such as /doctor:rebuild and fable-mode may appear only as removals in Upgrade Notes, never as live targets.
